title: gamut configuration
description: The gamut.json file at the module root. Command-line flags override these values.

mutators.description: Mutator types to run, the same as -only. Omit to run all.

exclude_files.description: Regular expressions (Go RE2 syntax) on module-relative, slash-separated file paths; matching files are not mutated. The same as -exclude-files.

timeout.description: The per-mutant timeout: the selected tests' baseline time times factor, plus min.

min.description: A Go duration such as "2s", the same as -timeout-min.

workers.description: Parallel test processes, the same as -workers.

tags.description: Build tags for loading, building, and type-checking, the same as -tags.

test_flags.description: Flags for every test binary run, such as "-short", the same as -test-flags.
